purpose: Freeze the performance-critical Tura execution semantics before the Native Codex thin-kernel migration.

cases.input_shape: provider turn completes without a tool call after the task is actually satisfied
required_observations: the runtime emits a user-facing assistant response
the response does not expose task_status or command_run internals
liveness alone is not treated as mission completion

cases.input_shape: two independent read commands share step 1 and one mutating command uses step 2
required_observations: the two reads may execute concurrently
the mutation cannot begin before step 1 is terminal
the mutation holds an exclusive workspace lock

cases.input_shape: step 2 consumes #@#${scan.stdout}#@#$ from a named step 1 command
required_observations: only a previous-step binding is admissible
exact placeholders preserve structured JSON values
embedded placeholders render a deterministic string

cases.input_shape: the provider response is interrupted after a command has a durable known terminal receipt
required_observations: the known terminal result is reconstructed from the receipt
the command effect is not executed again
an unknown outcome remains reconciliation-required and retry-unsafe

cases.input_shape: task_status updates task_group and task_type after the work it summarizes
required_observations: task topology is updated from the tool result
only selected task-scoped manuals are appended
the compact checkpoint replaces historical reasoning with current durable state
